value.answer: This needs urgent medical care now - go to the ER or call 911. A fever like this in a baby under 3 months can signal a serious infection and needs immediate evaluation, even if she seems otherwise okay.
value.triage: Do not wait or call 811 for this - go to the emergency room right now, or call 911 if she is hard to wake, floppy, struggling to breathe, or looks unwell. Any fever this age needs to be seen immediately.
